# DealsDrop — Black Friday & Cyber Monday 2026 deals

**Verified deals, dropped as they go live.**

**Why DealsDrop is different**

- **Every deal is verified.** Each one was checked on the vendor's own official page and links straight to it. Deals expire automatically: a daily bot flags deals past their end date.
- **Zero affiliate links or paid placements**, enforced by CI on every pull request.
- **Open data.** The full list is published as [JSON](generated/deals.json) and [CSV](generated/deals.csv) with category, discount, code and end-date fields.
- **Year-round seasons are coming.** Black Friday and Cyber Monday are live now; Christmas, Diwali, Prime Day and lifetime deals are coming.

**823 verified deals across 15 categories** — software, AI, hosting, courses, gadgets, home, fashion, gaming, travel and streaming, from stores in the US, India and worldwide. No affiliate links, no tracking parameters, no paid placements.

## How this list stays clean

- One YAML entry per deal, validated against [a JSON Schema](schema/deal.schema.json) on every pull request.
- Links must be on the vendor's own domain. Tracking parameters (`utm_*`, `ref`, `aff`, `via`, `tag` …), link shorteners and affiliate networks are rejected.
- Every deal must be confirmed on the vendor's own official page and needs a `verified_on` date and a GitHub handle. Vendors and employees must disclose.
- Descriptions are capped at 160 characters; hype words, emoji, exclamation marks and ALL CAPS are rejected.
- Max 3 deals per vendor (a short, maintainer-controlled list of big retailers such as Amazon and Flipkart may have up to 8, see [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md#big-retailer-exception-to-the-3-per-vendor-cap)), duplicate detection, weekly link checks and a daily job that flags expired deals.
